method: Two source-and-image reviews blinded to condition/timing, followed by a root-raised branch question applied consistently to all four pRetry cases. Original reviews and addenda retained. Root inspected both final 1440 light/dark captures. No candidate edits after author timing.
clause_index_convention: Luna initial indexes are one-based, Terra initial/revised indexes are zero-based; references to clause 3 here are one-based original task numbering.

cases.semantic_reason: Both independent source reviews accepted original visible task clauses; no contrary material evidence found in adjudication.

cases.semantic_reason: Original clause 3 requires actual callback conditions. The pre-callback exhausted-time branch still calls onFailedAttempt with retryDelay 0 and skips shouldConsumeRetry/shouldRetry (index.js:124-137); all four pRetry drafts omit this. P views also state a broad consume-first sequence. Both initial reviewers missed it and both revised on a consistent four-case source recheck.
cases.visual_reason: Original reviewers disagree; root agrees dense small edge text at default 1440 viewport does not meet perceptual acceptance. See visual-adjudication.json.

limits: Source review is evidence-backed human/agent judgement, not a semantic proof. Visual acceptance is a recorded perceptual adjudication with disagreement, not a changed machine threshold. Machine-failed missing captures remain unknown. Even accepting the permissive visual review would leave zero both-quality latency pairs because all B machine delivery failed.
